changelog:
- Initial release of the skill “thinking-lindy-effect” focusing on applying the Lindy Effect to technology and concept longevity decisions.
- Provides clear procedures for using the Lindy prior and domain drift checks when evaluating non-perishable options.
- Outlines criteria for when *not* to apply the Lindy heuristic, targeting perishable or paradigm-shift scenarios.
- Includes a structured output template for transparent documentation of choices.
- Offers falsification and over-application guards to ensure proper use.
summary: Use when longevity of a non-perishable option matters. Treat survival duration as a remaining-life prior, then check domain drift before favoring the proven.
